I saved a draft email to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines: proposed 2027 per-seat rate." It gives the $2,356-per-seat figure and says Dana is the source. It hasn't been sent, so Anselm can check it and send it.

- **Approval:** Per-seat rates normally can't go to someone outside finance without CFO or deal-desk sign-off. Anselm is the CFO and approved this himself, so I didn't need to ask anyone else. The email stays inside pemberline.com, so Ruth doesn't need to approve it either.
- **Figure not checked:** There are no Quarrendon files I can see, so I couldn't confirm the $2,356 rate. The draft uses the figure Anselm gave me.

I've also told Anselm in our direct messages that the draft is ready.
